title: Broken links in layout-aware-ocr.md, extractors/ocr/tesseract.md and stt-provider-comparison.md
description:
**Problem**
Three more docs pages contain dead links.

**Evidence**
- docs/examples/layout-aware-ocr.md
- docs/extractors/ocr/tesseract.md
- docs/benchmarks/stt-provider-comparison.md:347
(each has links whose targets do not exist in the repo or on the web, per the audit's link check).

**Fix**
Correct or remove the dead links; add `linkcheck` to CI so new ones are caught.

**How to verify**
`sphinx-build -b linkcheck docs docs/_build/linkcheck` reports no broken links for these three files.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
